card.line: Moreh is a place name tied to an oak near Shechem, where Abram stopped in Canaan, and to a hill near where Gideon's army faced Midian.

moments.title: Abram at the Oak of Moreh
moments.text: Abram traveled through Canaan as far as the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. There the LORD appeared to him and promised to give the land to his offspring, and Abram built an altar.

moments.title: A landmark for Israel
moments.text: Moses told Israel that Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal were near the Oak of Moreh. The blessing and the curse were to be proclaimed on those mountains when they entered the land.

moments.title: Gideon camps near Moreh
moments.text: Gideon and his men camped by the spring of Harod, with the camp of Midian north of them near the hill of Moreh. There the LORD cut Gideon's army down to three hundred men.
